claims.statement: docs/governance/OWNER_ACTIVATION_INPUTS.md states the check-run contexts and per-job harden-runner egress destinations for this repository, each traced to the hosted run it was read from, and the roadmap reflects them. VERIFIED by reading hosted runs on 2026-09-21: on pull-request head 2136b88a97f4bfe5f6e01220d1256a90d7c14838 the contexts validate, review, analyze and zizmor reported, and analysis reported only on the push to main at 1263f5008838f743b16ee218046e26dac5c9edd8; egress destinations are the 'endpoint called' lines from runs 35600183459, 35602225653, 35602870628 and 35602870625. VERIFIED by reading the workflow files: workflow-lint.yml filters its pull_request trigger to .github/workflows/** and .github/zizmor.yml, and scorecard.yml has no pull_request trigger, so neither zizmor nor analysis can be required without blocking pull requests that never emit them. VERIFIED at this commit: 180 tests pass under Python 3.12 and scripts/validate.sh reports all executed checks passed. INFERRED, not verified: that each job's destination list is complete, since each rests on a single run; the document says so and recommends moving one workflow to block at a time. Reported not run: agent-task-dispatch.yml has no run to read, so its egress is absent; no ruleset or egress policy was changed by this commit, and nothing here can change one.
